edits.new:
The harness asserts these rules and changes none of them; the rules themselves are evaluated in RWB-S9-E6033-APP, the ledger is P1's, the case is P3's and the rule versions are P7's.

Rule coverage: BR1, BR2 and BR3 are asserted by ITG AC2 and TC-E6-033-01-ITG; BR6 by ITG AC1 and TC-E6-033-01-ITG; BR7 by ITG AC2 and TC-E6-033-01-ITG; BR8 by ITG AC4 and ITG AC5 and TC-E6-033-02-ITG and TC-E6-033-04-ITG; BR9 by ITG AC3 and TC-E6-033-01-ITG. BR4 and BR5 have no criterion: their service-level and conflict-of-interest values are Not specified in the source documents (DOR-RWB-ITG-E6033-ITG-4).

Reference data: the rule package in force and the parameters of rwb-case are read through the reference-data contract (DP-06, DP-07); the parameters read are Not specified in the source documents (DOR-RWB-ITG-E6033-ITG-20).
